name: What is involved in wood fence panel repair?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in wood fence panel repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wood fence panel repair typically involves several steps. First, the damaged sections of the fence are assessed to determine the extent of the repair needed. This might include replacing broken pickets, repairing or replacing rotten posts, or reinforcing wobbly sections. The old or damaged materials are removed, and new wood is cut and installed to match the existing fence. Finally, the new sections are secured and, if desired, treated to match the rest of the fence. Frasheski Construction handles all aspects of this process for customers in Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair involves assessing damage, removing old materials, installing new wood, and securing the new sections. Frasheski Construction manages this process.
